'''Concrete''' was a compound consisting of cement, aggregate and water. The [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] of [[Alanciar]] used it to build aqueducts and buildings. That was one of the many things that sparked [[High Lord (Circle of Lords)|High Lord]] [[Edell Vrai]]'s interest in the [[Alanciari]] and proved to him their superiority to Keshiri on [[Keshtah Minor]].<ref name="Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium">''[[Lost Tribe of the Sith: Pandemonium]]''</ref>
